plan.notes: Official Plan of Study Grid: CAD/Mechanical Engineering Technology, A.A.S., Kirkwood Community College Credit Catalog 2026-2027 (creditcatalog.kirkwood.edu). All term totals and the program total (66) match the published grid exactly. Choice slots transcribed verbatim: DRF-142/EGT-400 (catalog also lists PLTW Introduction to Engineering Design as a high-school pathway alternative); four-option math pairings (MAT-102 Intermediate Algebra, MAT-138 College Algebra with Limits, MAT-136 Trigonometry & Analytic Geom, MAT-210 Calculus I; second math slot adds MAT-216 Calculus II); PHY-162/PHY-212 (College vs Classical Physics I) and PHY-172/PHY-222 (College vs Classical Physics II); MGT-145/PSY-111/ECN-120/ECN-130 social-science pairing. The three Engineering/Manufacturing Elective slots (3 cr each) draw from the program page's published elective course list; transfer students should consult an advisor for communications, math, physics, social science, and elective selection (catalog footnote 1). The grid publishes no per-course prerequisite list; the CAD-330->CAD-340->CAD-350 link follows the source's own Solidworks I->II->III naming.
